diagnostic_semantics.adequate_count_information_repetitions: Counts-only diagnostic; excludes unknown-fraction and global calibration conditions.
diagnostic_semantics.empty_domain_coverage: Vacuous physical [-1,1] counts in unconditional coverage but is never informative or a usable policy conclusion.
diagnostic_semantics.information_gate_statuses: Post-simulation diagnostic uses known synthetic population unknown fraction; not an observable-sample estimator or a replacement for future sample-weighted unknown-fraction gate.
